reasoning: The requirement that the graph consists of exactly two vertex‑disjoint cliques of size 3 and that every vertex belongs to one of these cliques can cover only 6 vertices, but the graph must have 11 vertices. Hence no such graph can exist.
cot_trace: We need graph with 11 vertices, but condition: consists of exactly 2 vertex-disjoint cliques of size 3 (every vertex belongs to one of these cliques, and the only edges are within these cliques). That uses 6 vertices total, but we have 11 vertices, and every vertex must belong to one of these cliques -> impossible because only 6 vertices can be in two cliques of size 3. So UNSAT.
